'''Chrysocolla''' is a low value [[gem]] found inside veins of [[malachite]].

[[File:Chrysocolla-270157.jpg|center|thumb|260px|Chrysocolla.]]

==In Real Life==
Chrysocolla is a form of hydrated copper silicate ((Cu,Al)<sub>2</sub>H<sub>2</sub>Si<sub>2</sub>O<sub>5</sub>(OH)<sub>4</sub>·nH<sub>2</sub>O) that forms from preexisting copper deposits; it is known to form alongside [[malachite]] and azurite (which is not present in Dwarf Fortress).
